explanation: No fault is supported by the supplied evidence. Job 2 consumed both exact upstream handoffs shown in its metadata, preserved all seven handed-off need records, mapped coverage by unchanged need text, ranked unsupported records first using upstream provenance rank, and recommended the first ranked unsupported need. The missing corpus record n06-r06 was not present in the upstream needs/evidence_sources handoffs, and the visible upstream selection logic only selects demand_score >= 6 plus fallback ids n06-r07 and n06-r08, so n06-r06 is not shown to be a required handoff record.
cited_evidence: Job 2 input needs and evidence_sources each contain seven records: n06-r01, n06-r02, n06-r03, n06-r04, n06-r05, n06-r07, and n06-r08.
Job 2 metadata reports consumed_handoffs ["needs", "evidence_sources"], coverage_count 7, and priority_count 7.
map_coverage source maps retained handoff needs to capability ids by exact need text and emits coverage 'direct' only when a matching capability_id exists.
prioritize source sorts by unsupported first, then upstream_rank, then record_id; observed priorities follow that order.
select_demand source selects records with demand_score >= 6 or fallback ids ['n06-r07', 'n06-r08'], which excludes n06-r06 with demand_score 5.
